entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [NET 11.0.0] Large P/Invoke string marshaling StackOverflowException still present (fix not in GA) #137601
  • Random access to large arrays is ~10% slower on .NET 11 on macOS Arm64 #137591
  • macOS arm64: SIGSEGV in find_first_object during background mark overflow on an in-range frozen (read-only) segment #137590
  • Swift compiler crashing while compiling System.Security.Cryptography.Native.Apple #137589
  • JIT: a no-return call in a compound assignment to a struct field keeps the struct in memory #137581
  • [wasm][mono][AOT] A struct holding an [InlineArray] passed by value between interpreted and AOT code: assert at interp.c:2737 / "function signature mismatch" (hit by BitVector256 on .NET 11) #137577
  • [wasm] The SDK's crossgen2 targets ignore PublishReadyToRunInstructionSet #137571
    12.0.0
  • .NET and Native AOT binary size improvements for CsWinRT 3.0 and native Windows apps #137567
  • [API Proposal]: JsonSourceGenerationOptionsAttribute.EmitAttributeProviders to opt out of generated attribute provider reflection #137566
  • [wasi] Express WASI and single-threaded limitations through platform annotations #137564
    12.0.0

Closed

  • Microsoft.NETCore.Native.Windows.targets includes "Synchronization.lib" when it's actually "synchronization.lib" #137588
  • NativeAOT fails to resolve generic method signatures in ILLink.Substitutions.xml on .NET 11 (IL2009) #137576
